summary: This is the MoveIt Setup Assistant tutorial (Humble docs), a GUI walkthrough for configuring a robot for MoveIt, using the Franka Panda as the example. It covers 12 steps from loading the URDF xacro to generating the panda_moveit_config package, including self-collision matrix, virtual joints, planning groups, poses, end effectors, 3D perception, Gazebo simulation and ROS Control. The main output is an SRDF file plus other configuration files for the MoveIt pipeline.
one_line: Step-by-step tutorial for using the MoveIt Setup Assistant GUI to generate SRDF and configuration files for the Franka Panda robot.
key_facts: The MoveIt Setup Assistant is a graphical user interface for configuring any robot for use with MoveIt; its primary function is generating a Semantic Robot Description Format (SRDF) file.
The tutorial uses the Franka Panda, loading panda_arm_hand.urdf.xacro from /opt/ros/noetic/share/franka_description/robots/ after installing ros-noetic-franka-description.
The Setup Assistant is started with 'roslaunch moveit_setup_assistant setup_assistant.launch', offering Create New or Edit Existing MoveIt Configuration Package.

The self-collision matrix generator disables link pairs that are always in collision, never in collision, in collision in the default position, or adjacent on the kinematic chain; the default sampling density is 10,000 collision checks.
A single virtual joint named 'virtual_joint' of type fixed attaches panda_link0 to the world frame.
The planning group 'panda_arm' uses kdl_kinematics_plugin/KDLKinematicsPlugin and includes joints from virtual_joint through panda_joint8.
The 'hand' planning group has kinematic solver None and consists of links panda_hand, panda_leftfinger and panda_rightfinger.
The 'hand' group is labeled as an end effector with panda_link8 as the Parent Link and Parent Group left blank.
The Panda has no passive joints, so Step 7 is skipped; passive joints are unactuated joints like passive casters.
The 3D Perception tab configures the sensors_3d.yaml file; choose None if it is not needed.
The ROS Control step adds 'arm_position_controller' of type position_controllers/JointPositionController using all joints of the panda_arm group.
The final step generates the package 'panda_moveit_config', which does not need to be within the ROS package path.
Next suggested steps are the MoveIt RViz Plugin and setting up the faster IKFast inverse kinematics solver.
The docs are the Humble version, noted as a stable version no longer developed further, © 2024 PickNik Robotics.
